_template_note: Template for outputs/pesn/v542_backbone_50k/plan/budget_policy.json (plan §11 / ADR-0033). WP0 ships PRE-PROFILE: per_candidate entries are null with status pending_wp3_profiling; the prereg validator passes (t1_blocked only) while --formal is the typed block V542_BUDGET_NULL. Fill each entry from the same-env V542 40+40 profile_only measurement BEFORE formal T1 and re-hash into budget_policy_sha256. Fixed-dose 37,900 updates is immutable. A1-C/A5-C are full-dose diagnostics and require their own profile/cost/budget entries before activation.
_t1_block_rule: per_candidate.*.approved_for_formal must all be true for admitted candidates before formal T1; validator refuses --formal while budget.per_candidate_core_time is null (V542_BUDGET_NULL)

activation_summary.A5_full_dose: conditional: only when no A1-A4 H3-qualified candidate after top2 seeds (else gate_skipped); launch_requires diagnostic/cost/H0/H1 gates
activation_summary.top2_note: top2 belongs to A1-A4 ONLY (max 2 candidates x seeds 29/43 = 4 runs); A5 T3 rows are a separate a5_supplement branch (max 2 runs) gated by a5_full_dose_complete_and_seed17_screen_pass
activation_summary.A1C_attribution: conditional full-dose diagnostic: A1 enters top-2 supplement set OR is selected as Backbone*; requires H0 fixture + conditional smoke 200 + 40+40 profile + cost gate + budget record
activation_summary.A5C_attribution: conditional full-dose diagnostic: A5 SELECTED as Backbone* only; same H0/smoke/profile/cost/budget prerequisites; if A5 H3-qualified but not selected => capacity_caveat_unresolved, do NOT run
activation_summary.diagnostic_2000: V542_DIAG_A0_S17 (matched-dose reference) + V542_DIAG_A1-A5_S17 — unconditional engineering screens

cost_acceptance.denominator: same V542 environment, same batch, same 40 W0 + 40 W1 profile measured A0
cost_acceptance.on_exceed: gate_skipped_cost_ratio_exceeds_2 — scientific result retained, no promotion, A0 stays (NOT resource_failure); no layer/head/frame reduction to 'fix' cost

cost_model.extrapolation_rule: 200 W0 updates may NOT be extrapolated to W1 joint timing; profile windows label frozen-core vs unfrozen-core

A5.activation: conditional on no A1-A4 H3-qualified candidate

A1-C.role: full-dose attribution diagnostic (37,900 updates); requires H0 fixture + conditional smoke 200 + 40+40 profile + cost gate before activation

A5-C.role: full-dose capacity-caveat diagnostic (37,900 updates); requires H0 fixture + conditional smoke 200 + 40+40 profile + cost gate before activation

schedule.fixed_dose_note: 正式训练始终固定 37,900 updates；fixed-GPU-time 只作另报成本匹配分析，不替代同剂量主比较

n_core_note: N_core counts NEW TRAINING runs via the frozen formula (runplan_pin.core_training_count_formula); smoke/profile are technical measurements excluded from N_core; top2 ceiling 4 + a5_supplement ceiling 2
